method_baseline: docs/paper4_methodology.md; reports/paper4_action_plan.json remains the earlier DBMS baseline
question: Does Badger's hybrid symbolic/fuzzing architecture improve worst-case Java input discovery over cost-guided fuzzing at matched CPU and time?

nodes.claim: Hybrid cooperation improves maximum discovered resource cost under matched resources.
The source's observed gain is mainly resource imbalance, subject selection or noise.
Authors acknowledge two-process hybrid versus single-core component comparison and propose a fairer parallel comparison.
HotFuzz independently finds Java algorithmic-complexity witnesses, but does not compare Badger and KelinciWCA.
Pinned builds, fair CPU measurement, held-out subjects and direct paired maximum-cost outcomes are missing.

explicit_scenario_assumptions_not_empiri.warning: The sensitivity, specificity and feasibility values are declared illustrative assumptions, not measured probabilities. Change them in sensitivity analysis before using any action ranking as empirical evidence.

candidate_actions.action: Pin and build Badger plus standalone KelinciWCA; inspect cost metric, process topology, benchmarks and CPU telemetry. Stop if irreproducible.
candidate_actions.direct_information_gain_about_H1: near zero until a build or metric failure changes feasibility

candidate_actions.action: If A1 passes, preregister a paired independent-program matched-CPU comparison with randomized arm order and repeat seeds.
candidate_actions.cost_assumption: at least 12 person-hours plus local CPU; exact budget to freeze after A1

candidate_actions.action: Repeat broad keyword search on the old 13 questions without citation/definition tracing.
candidate_actions.information_gain: not estimable from available evidence; first pass had zero direct labels and 9/13 weak retrieval states

selected_next_action: A1, followed by A2 only if reproducibility and a fair measured cost metric are established
baseline_comparison: A1 is the lowest-commitment prerequisite; A2 has the largest hypothetical direct entropy reduction but is gated by A1. A3 is a simple repeat-search baseline with no calibrated likelihood model. This is not observed planner utility.
